title: Sariema project
description: A game project's sariema.json: where its assets are and which rooms it has.

assets_root.description: Directory the room descriptions' kit, montagem and luz paths are relative to. A relative path is resolved from the project directory.

rooms.description: Room id to the path of its room description (schemas/room.schema.json), relative to the project directory.

game.description: The game: its logic crate built to WebAssembly, its cutscenes and runtime settings. `sariema build` without --room builds them into a game pack.

logic.description: Directory of the logic crate (a cdylib using sariema-sdk), relative to the project directory.

cutscenes.description: Directory whose *.json files are cutscenes (schemas/cutscene.schema.json), relative to the project directory.

settings.description: Runtime settings overriding the defaults; `sariema api --json` lists every key.

toolchain.description: rustup toolchain that builds the logic, such as 1.100.0; without it, the cargo on PATH, which needs the wasm32-unknown-unknown target.
